links.name: Lu4
Summon Life Cubic Lv. 1 Summons a Life Cubic. The Life Cubic uses magic to regenerate HP to its owner and party members.
Summon Smart Cubic Lv. 1 Summons Smart Cubic. This Cubic: Inflicts magic damage on enemy. Stuns enemy. Removes all debuffs from the master.
Heal Lv. 1 Restores the target's HP with 50 Power.
Cure Poison Lv. 1 Cures the target of minor poisoning.
Battle Heal Lv. 1 Immediately restores the target's HP with 83 Power.
Group Heal Lv. 1 Restores all party members' HP with 66 Power.
Servitor Recharge Lv. 1 Recovers the servitor's MP with up to 41 Power depending on the servitor's level.
Servitor Heal Lv. 1 Recovers the servitor's HP with 169 Power.
Aqua Swirl Lv. 1 Supplements the user's M. Atk. with 23 Power to create a powerful vortex of Water that inflicts Water damage on an enemy.
Wind Strike Lv. 1 Supplements the user's M. Atk. with 12 Power to create a powerful hurricane that inflicts Wind damage on an enemy.
Summon Boxer the Unicorn Lv. 1 Summons Boxer the Unicorn.
Summon Mirage the Unicorn Lv. 1 Summons Mirage the Unicorn for assistance in combat.
Summon Merrow the Unicorn Lv. 1 Summons the servitor Merrow the Unicorn.
Summon Aqua Cubic Lv. 1 Summons Aqua Cubic. Aqua Cubic uses attack magic that inflicts continuous damage to an enemy.
Servitor Cure Lv. 1 Cures servitor of minor bleeding or poisoning.
Servitor Blessing Lv. 1 Frees servitor of Hold, paralysis and decreased Atk. Spd. or movement effects.
Mass Summon Aqua Cubic Lv. 1 Summons Aqua Cubic for party members. Aqua Cubic uses attack magic that inflicts continuous damage to an enemy.
Summon Friend Lv. 1 Teleports a party member to one's current location. Requires a Summon Crystal on the target.
Summon Magnus the Unicorn Lv. 1 Summon the servitor Magnus the Unicorn.
Dimension Spiral Lv. 1 Creates a tear in the dimension to inflict damage on an enemy with 57 Power added to M. Atk. Over-hit is possible.
Replace Lv. 1 Switches locations with the target servitor. Range: 700 Cooldown: 60 seconds.
Concentration Lv. 1 Chance to interrupt magic casting -18%.
Servitor Magic Shield Lv. 1 Increases the servitor's M. Def. by 18%.
Servitor Physical Shield Lv. 1 Increases the servitor's P. Def. by 10%.
Servitor Haste Lv. 1 Increases the servitor's Atk. Spd. by 21%.
Bright Servitor Lv. 1 Increases the servitor's M. Atk. by 40%.
Servitor Empowerment Lv. 1 Increases the servitor's P. Def. by 1800, M. Def. by 1350, and resistance to buff-canceling attacks by 80%. It is unable to move while the skill is in effect.
Servitor Barrier Lv. 1 Makes the servitor invincible.
Improved Combat Lv. 1 Combines 'Might' and 'Shield' effects. P. Atk. +6% P. Def. +6%.

Spirit Sharing Lv. 1 Increases the user's P. Atk. by 3%, M. Atk. by 3%, skill P. Atk. by 5%, Atk. Spd. by 2%, Cast. Spd. by 1%, and critical rate by 5%. The effect applies to both the master and their summon.
Servitor Share Lv. 1 Extends the summoner's abilities to the servitor: 50% of P. Atk./P. Def. 25% of M. Atk./M. Def. 15% of Max HP/MP 25% of P. Crit. Rate 15% of Atk. Spd. 5% of Cast. Spd.
Mass Improved Combat Lv. 1 Combines 'Might' and 'Shield' effects. For party members: P. Atk. +6% P. Def. +6%.
Wind Shackle Lv. 1 Decreases an enemy's Atk. Spd. by 17%.
Betray Lv. 1 Cause's enemy servitor to attack its master.
Mass Surrender to Water Lv. 1 Resistance to Water -19%. When applied, cancels 'Resist Aqua' and prevents it from being rebuffed.
Common Craft Lv. 1 Can read common recipe books.
Arcane Agility Lv. 1 Cast. Spd. +20% M. Skills Reuse Time -10% M. Skills MP Consumption +10%. Consumes 35 HP per second.
Transfer Pain Lv. 1 Transfers 10% of received damage to a servitor. MP is continuously consumed proportional to user's level.
Block Buff Lv. 1 Switchable skill. Your character cannot receive external buff effects.
Magic Firework Lv. 1 Magic outside of Hogwarts!
Magician's Movement Lv. 1 Without Robe Armor: Atk. Spd. -20%.
Spellcraft Lv. 1 Without Robe Armor: Cast. Spd. -50%.
Mana Recovery Lv. 1 With Robe Armor: MP Regeneration +20%.
Robe Mastery Lv. 1 With Robe Armor: P. Def. +2 M. Def. +1%.
Expertise D Lv. 1 Increases expertise in using D-grade equipment.
Armor Mastery Lv. 1 P. Def. +6.7.
Weapon Mastery Lv. 1 Increases P. Atk. by 1.5 and M. Atk. by 1.9.
Light Armor Mastery Lv. 1 With Light Armor: P. Def. +11 Cast. Spd. +88% Atk. Spd. +25% MP Regeneration +20%.
Create Common Item Lv. 1 Creates level 1 common items.
Anti Magic Lv. 1 M. Def. +10.
Quick Recycle Lv. 1 Decreases Reuse Delay for magic by 10%.
Lucky Lv. 1 At lv 10 or lower, the user will not experience loss of Exp, and after-death effect upon death.
Fast HP Recovery Lv. 1 Increases HP Recovery Bonus by 1.1.
Boost Mana Lv. 1 Increases Max MP by 30.
Fast Spell Casting Lv. 1 Cast. Spd. +5%.
Fast Mana Recovery Lv. 1 Increases MP Recovery Bonus by 1.1.
Higher Mana Gain Lv. 1 Additionally increases recovery +22 MP when used Recharge skill.
Wisdom Lv. 1 Resistance to Hold +10% Resistance to Sleep +10% Resistance to Mental attacks +10%.
Cubic Mastery Lv. 1 Ability to summon 2 Cubics at once.
Fighter's Will Lv. 1 With any weapon: P. Skills Power +5% P. Crit. Rate +5%. With short-range weapon: P. Atk. +5% Atk. Spd. +5%.
Archer's Will Lv. 1 With any weapon: Speed +2 Accuracy +3. Only with Bow: P. Atk. +5% Skills Range +5% Attack Range +50.
Magician's Will Lv. 1 M. Atk. +5% Cast. Spd. +5% M. Crit. Rate +5% All skills MP Consumption -5%.
Divine Inspiration Lv. 1 Increases the number of buffs an individual can receive by 1 (+1: 20 => 21).
Spell Mastery Lv. 1 Depending on user's INT, the re-use time resets or the duration doubles.
Summon Lore Lv. 1 M. Skills MP Consumption -2%. With Light Armor: P. Def. +20 Cast. Spd. +2%. With Robe Armor: P. Def. +15 Cast. Spd. +3%.
Excessive Loyalty Lv. 1 When the master takes damage, 30% chance for the servitor: P. Atk. +35% M. Atk. +75% P. Crit. Rate +30% P. Crit. Damage +35%. Duration: 20 sec.
Mutual Response Lv. 1 Ordinary attacks have a 5% chance for the servitor: Restores HP. Power: 420. Restores MP. Power: 70.
PvE Clarity Lv. 1 Single target's M. Skills MP Consumption in PvE only: -30%.
